_meta.tweak_via: edit this file + commit; the /api/system/health endpoint and the system-resource-watch timer both read it on next invocation (no reload)
_meta.rationale: Honest box-level resource-health thresholds. warning = 'getting tight, worth a look'; critical = 'real trouble, DM Larry + top of Approvals'. Deliberately quiet on the reclaimable-page-cache false class that made the old single-cgroup gauge cry wolf (see scripts/system_resource_health.py header). Defaults live in DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS; only override keys you want to change.
